SalarisFeed.title: Salaris Feed
SalarisFeed.description: Raw salarisbureau import batch materialised before mapping to balanced JournalEntry records and. Decouples 'what came in' from 'what got booked' and provides an audit trail for reconciliation when a batch fails halfway.

salarisbureauSlug.description: FK to the openconnector source slug that delivered this batch. One of adp-salaris-nl, loket-salaris-nl, visma-salaris-nl, nmbrs-salaris-nl.
salarisbureauSlug.title: Salarisbureau Slug

payrollPeriod.description: Payroll period identifier (YYYY-MM format). Each batch covers one loontijdvak per employee.
payrollPeriod.title: Loontijdvak

employeeId.description: External employee identifier as supplied by the salarisbureau.
employeeId.title: Employee ID

employeeName.description: Employee display name for reconciliation reference.
employeeName.title: Employee Name

payrollCost.description: Total loonkosten (gross wage cost) for this employee in this loontijdvak in EUR. This is the DR side of the journal entry.
payrollCost.title: Loonkosten

netPay.description: Net salary to be paid to the employee (CR side).
netPay.title: Nettoloon

socialePremies.description: Employer social premiums (WW, ZW, WAO/WIA etc.) — CR side.
socialePremies.title: Sociale Premies

payrollTax.description: Wage tax withheld (loonbelasting + premie volksverzekeringen) — CR side.
payrollTax.title: Loonheffing

rawPayload.description: Raw feed payload as received from the salarisbureau. Stored verbatim for audit and reconciliation.
rawPayload.title: Raw Payload

importState.description: Processing state of this salaris-feed record.
importState.title: Import State

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry materialised from this feed record after mapping.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this import batch.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

received.label: Received
received.description: Raw feed payload received from the salarisbureau; not yet mapped to JournalEntry.

mapped.label: Mapped
mapped.description: Balanced JournalEntry of subtype loonkosten successfully materialised from this feed record.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Mapping failed; see rawPayload for diagnostic. Operator must review before retry.

map.label: Map to journal entry
map.description: Mapping engine materialised a balanced JournalEntry of subtype loonkosten.

retry.label: Retry mapping
retry.description: Reset to received state for a fresh mapping attempt.

toJournalEntryLoonkosten.description: Declarative mapping from SalarisFeed to a balanced JournalEntry of subtype loonkosten. Produces loonkosten DR = nettoloon CR + socialePremies CR + loonheffing CR + pensioen CR per employee per loontijdvak. Satisfies and balance invariant. No PHP mapper service per ADR-031.

balanceInvariant.diagnostic: SalarisFeed mapping produced unbalanced JournalEntry: debit={{debitTotal}} credit={{creditTotal}} (€0 tolerance per REQ-DPA-002 + REQ-GL-001)

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Salaris Feed is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

OpdrachtgeversVerklaring.title: Opdrachtgevers Verklaring
OpdrachtgeversVerklaring.description: Wet DBA (Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties) position record per ZZP assignment. Declares the opdrachtgever-opdrachtnemer relationship and risicobeoordeling. No PHP DBA service — lifecycle and document rendering are declarative per ADR-031.

zzpId.description: External identifier for the ZZP-er (self-employed contractor).
zzpId.title: ZZP ID

assignmentDescription.description: Description of the assignment (opdracht) that this verklaring covers.
assignmentDescription.title: Opdracht Beschrijving

declarationStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the opdrachtgeversverklaring.
declarationStatus.title: Verklaring Status

modelAgreement.description: URI to the Belastingdienst model overeenkomst used as the basis for this verklaring. Optional when a non-model-contract variant applies.
modelAgreement.title: Model Overeenkomst

declarationDocumentUri.description: docudesk attachment URI of the generated opdrachtgeversverklaring document. Populated after the 'generate document' action triggers the docudesk template render.
declarationDocumentUri.title: Verklaring Document URI

riskAssessment.description: Wet DBA risk classification. Operator-classified. The docudesk template renders the chosen risico.
riskAssessment.title: Risico Beoordeling

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this opdrachtgeversverklaring.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Verklaring is being drafted; not yet agreed upon by both parties.

overeengekomen.label: Overeengekomen
overeengekomen.description: Both parties have agreed on the assignment terms and Wet DBA position.

beëindigd.label: Beëindigd
beëindigd.description: Assignment has ended; verklaring is archived.

overeenkomen.label: Overeenkomst bevestigen
overeenkomen.description: Both parties confirm agreement. Triggers document generation via docudesk template.

beëindigen.label: Verklaring beëindigen
beëindigen.description: Assignment has ended; marks the verklaring as beëindigd.

onOvereenkomen.description: Trigger docudesk template render of the standaard opdrachtgeversverklaring. The generated document URI is written back to verklaringDocumentUri.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Opdrachtgevers Verklaring is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IB47Record.title: IB47 Record
IB47Record.description: Annual IB47 form payload per recipient for submission to the Belastingdienst. BSN is stored encrypted at-rest and RBAC-restricted to the payroll-officer role and Risk 3. Aggregation over a tax year is declarative via x-openregister-aggregations per (belastingjaar, opdrachtgeverId). Every BSN access logs to audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022.

taxYear.description: Tax year this IB47 record covers.
taxYear.title: Belastingjaar

clientId.description: FK to the Administration (opdrachtgever) that made the betalingen.
clientId.title: Opdrachtgever ID

recipientName.description: Full name of the payment recipient (ontvanger).
recipientName.title: Ontvanger Naam

recipientBSN.description: Burger Service Nummer of the recipient. Stored encrypted at-rest per x-openregister-encryption. Read restricted to payroll-officer role per RBAC and ADR-022. Every read access is logged to audit-trail-immutable.
recipientBSN.title: Ontvanger BSN

recipientAddress.description: Full postal address of the recipient as required by the IB47 form.
recipientAddress.title: Ontvanger Adres

paymentsTotal.description: Total payments made to this recipient in the belastingjaar (EUR ≥ 0).
paymentsTotal.title: Betalingen Totaal

paymentTypeCode.description: Belastingdienst IB47 payment type code per the IB47 schema 2026.
paymentTypeCode.title: Betaling Type Code

isDryRun.description: When true this is a monthly dry-run record. When false this contributes to the final yearly batch. The aggregation invariant requires that the final yearly batch totals equal the sum of 12 monthly dry-runs (€0 tolerance).
isDryRun.title: Is Dry Run

dryRunMonth.description: Month number (1-12) this dry-run covers. Only meaningful when isDryRun = true.
dryRunMonth.title: Dry Run Month

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this IB47 record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

ib47TotalsPerTaxYear.description: Per-tax-year IB47 aggregation grouping IB47Record by (belastingjaar, opdrachtgeverId). Produces betalingenTotaal per recipient per year. Used for the final yearly batch assembly and for the dry-run vs final reconciliation invariant: final totals MUST equal sum of 12 monthly dry-runs (€0 tolerance).

ib47DryRunTotalsPerMonth.description: Monthly dry-run aggregation for the reconciliation invariant check. Must equal the final yearly batch totals per recipient (€0 tolerance).

ib47ReconciliationCheck.description: Invariant check: final yearly batch totals per recipient MUST equal the sum of 12 monthly dry-run totals (€0 tolerance). Surfaced as a non-blocking warning when the invariant is violated before submission.

onIb47BatchSubmitted.subject: IB47 batch submitted
onIb47BatchSubmitted.description: Notify the payroll-officer when the IB47 yearly batch has been transmitted to the Belastingdienst via openconnector. Declarative fan-out per ADR-031. KNOWN GAP (migrate-legacy-notification-dialect): trigger is still the bare-string legacy shape — IB47Record has no status/lifecycle field for a canonical `transition` trigger to hook into; the batch-submitted event is fired by the openconnector transmission step, not an object state change. Needs a schema decision (add a submission-status field, or a new non-transition trigger type) before this rule can dispatch through the declarative engine; tracked as follow-up, not fixed by this change.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a IB47 Record is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
